measurementRules.rule: Use actual complete-stamp net mass after first quality release. Measure each configuration on a calibrated balance excluding removable liner and packaging. Q is the sum of these measured masses; complete-stamp count is an independent reconciliation. If a count conversion is needed, M is measured net mass in kg of one complete stamp of that same configuration, with its sampled/individual weighing and range recorded in cp_release; count times M is permitted only for the matched configuration and period. Never infer M from geometry, a secondary native factor or a different component.

Select disjoint component receipts or one reconciled whole-article bridge. Included polymer, fillers, adhesive, assay water and detachable liner subaccounts must reconcile to the one wet receipt. Preserve full closing retained mass and every inherited vector, including test-pad ink and installed adsorption media; never add the same component to whole wet article mass.

Use the selected Flow reference property and its exact versioned unit group, then its true reference unit. Preserve raw meter units before conversion; kWh to MJ uses 3.6 only in the verified energy group. Already integrated liquid/gas volume is not multiplied by time; integrate only an actual rate. Each substance needs independent density at recorded state. Item(s) and item are count aliases with factor 1, never kg per item.

Close total wet physical mass and relevant independently assayed element balances separately from molecular/reactive-water balances. Measure N2, O2, Ar, H2O and every actual molecular inlet/outlet with its true medium and carbon origin when a gas gate is used. Retain gross wet flow, species and net environmental exchange separately. Do not infer two unknowns from one residual or use VOC/COD/NOx/PM indicators as molecules. Record actual hot-fluid Product returns with mass, phase, T/P and enthalpy; match one supplier water/heat convention and do not duplicate carrier kg with heat MJ or invent a boiler/steam loop.

calculationRules.rule: Q = sum of measured complete-stamp net mass for unique first-release events in the cohort. If count conversion is used, mass = matched configuration count times measured M from cp_release. Do not add closing released FG or component outputs again.

A_e=B_open,e+U_new,e−B_close,e−T_other,e for genuinely unused/unassigned raw/WIP exchange vectors. U_new before stock correction includes all actual modes; not repeated if already corrected. AcceptedFG/performedservice not unused. Own inherited history vs aggregate/decomposed providers nonoverlap, never add embedded supply work twice. Full physical V_e stocks/transfers independently complete.

q_e,c=A_e,c/original positive Q0,c once, using evidenced nonoverlapping compatible provider units. Physical V or Qt/Q_analysis is observation only, not a repeated shared provider demand or a shrunken export. Full receiver/provider quantities once, components/provenance and service vectors separate. Actual Q=0/unknown basis keeps raw without unitresult.

For original cohort c observed within H, A_service_c contains only actual incremental observed service loads, retaining full historical manufacture vectors and exact original-delivery reversals separately. Use D = original_Q_c for that cohort in the same one-division rule. Manufacture and FG service accounts combine by cancelling matched internal handoff and adding each actual load once. Do not substitute current dispatch count/mass, net returned sales, current Q or a future assumed service horizon for original_Q_c.

Independent full physical gates preserve actual wet mass/species and original-event Q0 dispositions. Matching manufacture/FG internal handoff cancels once. Each actual packaging pool uses O+P+I+ER+J_in+H2O_in=C+S_filled+EO_empty+W_whole+J_out+H2O_out. Jnonwater and H2O real disjoint legs exclude already nested transfers; X onlyOTHERsame-sideduplicate not trueincrement/fullwetC/opposite. Wwhole includes substrate/retainedmatter/water once. Original eventQ0 never newexternal output.

Use independent measured inlet/outlet species, wet mass, material assays and relevant element observations to report separate physical, elemental and molecular residuals with uncertainties. Integrate only actual rates over their observed interval; do not multiply an already integrated volume by time. Preserve free/reaction/absorbed/structure water and real gas species/carbon origins. An unexplained residual is a gap, not a fitted emission or simultaneous solution of multiple unknowns.

measurementRules.rule: 采用首次质量放行后完整印章的实际净质量。每种配置用校准秤称量，排除可移除衬材及包装。Q 为这些实测质量之和；完整件数用于独立核对。如需件数换算，M 为同一配置一件完整印章的实测千克净质量，逐件或抽样称量方法及配置范围记入 cp_release；仅同配置同期间可用件数乘 M。不得从几何、原生次级系数或不同部件推定 M。
选择互不重叠的独立组分收货，或一个已对账整件制品桥接。已含聚合物、填料、胶、分析含水及可移除衬材子账需与单一湿收货对上。保留完整期末留存质量及每个继承向量，包括试印垫留墨和在用吸附介质；整件湿质量不得再加同组分。

measurementRules.required_property: 所选原子交换的实际属性
measurementRules.rule: 使用所选 Flow 参考属性及其精确版本单位组，再取真实参考单位。保留原始表计单位后再换算；kWh 到 MJ 的 3.6 仅用于已核实能量单位组。已积分液气体积不能再乘时间，只有真实速率才积分。每种物质需记录状态下独立密度。Item(s) 与 item 是因子 1 的件数别名，不是每件千克。

measurementRules.applies_to: 制造 FG 及合并平衡
measurementRules.rule: 全湿物理质量及相关独立分析元素平衡，与分子或反应水平衡分别闭合。采用气体门时，分别测量 N2、O2、Ar、H2O 及每种实际进出分子，记录真实介质和碳来源；湿毛流、物种及净环境交换分别保留。不用一个残差推两个未知，也不将 VOC、COD、NOx、PM 指标当分子。真实载热流体 Product 返还需记录质量、相态、温压及焓，匹配一个供方水热约定，载体 kg 与热 MJ 不双购，不虚构锅炉或蒸汽回路。

calculationRules.rule: Q = 队列内唯一首次放行事件的完整印章实测净质量之和。使用件数换算时，质量 = 匹配配置件数乘 cp_release 的实测 M。不能再次增加已放行期末 FG 或部件产出。
A_e=B_open,e+U_new,e−B_close,e−T_other,e用于真实未用未归属原料WIP逐交换向量。U_new为库存修正前全部实际模式，已修正不再扣。已验收FG已执行服务非未用结存。自身继承史与聚合拆解供方不重叠，不重复内含生产。完整实物V_e库存转移独立。
